{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lurid Gundarks''' was a criminal gang that operated in [[Tolea Biqua]] on [[Genarius]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were led by [[Carlin]] and based in the ''[[Chancellor's Head]]'' pub. When [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] returned to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and retook control of crime there, the Gundarks refused to join his new organization. Riboga sent a group of his minions, lead by [[Mok Cadrak]], to Tolea Biqua to attack the Gundarks and they confronted them inside the ''[[Chancellor's Head]]''. With the help of the [[Heroes of Cularin]], the Gundarks were able to defeat the Hutt enforcers.
